events.description: One chain's stored record was added, removed or altered. Re-read `get_beacon_config`.
events.name: beacon_config_changed

methods.description:
Seed the built-in providers, per provider and only where absent; a default the user
removed is never re-added. Any consumer may call it, any number of times.
`{ ok, applied, seeded: { "<chainId>": [id, ...] } }`.
methods.name: init_defaults

methods.description: No network I/O. `{ ok, state: unready|unconfigured|configured, chains: [...] }`.
methods.name: config_status

methods.description: `{ ok, config: { providers, proxy?, proxyRequired, timeoutSecs } }`.
methods.name: get_beacon_config

methods.description:
Patch `proxy` / `proxyRequired` / `timeoutSecs`, and replace `providers` when given.
Omitted keeps; `"proxy": null` clears. Creates the chain if absent.
methods.name: set_beacon_config

methods.description: `{ ok, chainId, network, providers: [{ id, endpoint, enabled, source, https, health }] }`.
methods.name: list_providers

methods.description: `provider_json`: `{ endpoint, id?, enabled? }`. An omitted id is derived from the host.
methods.name: add_provider

methods.description:
Live check of one provider: whether it serves the light-client API, with the
`Eth-Consensus-Version` header the verified proxy needs, and its slot lag.
methods.name: provider_health

methods.description:
One light-client request, named as libverifproxy's beacon transport names it:
`getLightClientBootstrap` `{block_root}`, `getLightClientUpdatesByRange`
`{start_period, count}`, `getLightClientOptimisticUpdate`, `getLightClientFinalityUpdate`.
`provider` (may be empty) is tried first; the others follow on any failure.
`deadline_ms` bounds the whole failover (0 = 30 s, capped at 600 s).
`{ ok, provider, body, attempts }`; `body` is the provider's JSON text, verbatim.
methods.name: lc_request

methods.description:
The finalized header from https providers only. A starting point to show a user, not a
trust anchor. `{ ok, root, slot, provider, endpoint }`.
methods.name: finalized_header

methods.description: A GET under `/eth/v1/` or `/eth/v2/`, for diagnostics. `{ ok, provider, result }`.
methods.name: raw_get

methods.description: The module's name, as declared in its metadata.
methods.name: name

methods.description: The module's version, as declared in its metadata.
methods.name: version

methods.description: The module's canonical LIDL interface document.
methods.name: lidl
